_about: Inputs for the 10 kW DAB primary half-bridge heat sink. Geometry from AIPE-CAD-Agent, operating point and loss model from AIPE-Thermal-Design (which takes its currents from the AIPE waveform run and its device data from the TI TIDA-010054 fact sheet). Every value here is an input with a stated source; nothing in this file is a result of this example.

cad._source: AIPE-CAD-Agent examples/dab-10kw (commit b81bf69, 2026-10-22): dab_heatsink.step and dab_heatsink.metadata.json, generated by FreeCAD 1.1.4 from params/heatsink.json

operating_point._source: AIPE-Thermal-Design src/aipe_thermal/cases/dab_10kw.py: primary switch I_rms from the AIPE waveform run dab-l1-nominal-ic; R_DS(on), R_th,jc and the turn-off placeholder from the TI TIDA-010054 fact sheet; R_DS(on) hot factor is a same-family proxy (C3M0040120K) - all labelled assumptions there
operating_point.converter: 10 kW DAB, 800 V -> 400 V, 100 kHz; this sink carries one primary half-bridge (two C3M0075120K-class SiC MOSFETs, TO-247-4L)

cooling._source: Nominal h = 34.394 W/m^2/K is the forced-air film coefficient recorded by AIPE-Thermal-Design for its two-fan Al 100 x 100 x 46 mm plate-fin option (fin gap 3 mm) in the same DAB case (docs/validation.md). The CAD sink (fin gap 3.5 mm, 35 mm fins) is similar but not identical, so h is swept.

materials._source: aipe_fieldsim.materials: Al-6063-T5 k = 209 W/m/K (as AIPE-Thermal-Design), 96 % alumina k = 24 W/m/K

mesh._note: Maximum element size per level: global, device region, isolation pad (0.25 mm thick). Level 1 is used for the h sweep.
